config.sql:
select * from (
  select coalesce((select max(a.status) from insur_goods_upload_record a
                    where a.trade_type = '3501' and a.pk_key = v.pk_value and a.status <> '9'), '0') send_flag,
         v.med_list_codg, v.fixmedins_hilist_id, v.fixmedins_hilist_name, v.rx_flag,
         v.invdate, v.inv_cnt, v.manu_lotnum, v.fixmedins_bchno, v.manu_date, v.expy_end,
         v.memo, v.drug_trac_codg, v.pk_value
    from v_gjyhyb_goods_invinfo v
) t where t.send_flag <> '1'

config.body: {infno: '3501', msgid: sign.msgid, insuplc_admdvs: '${var.gdyb.admvs:440100}', mdtrtarea_admvs: '${var.gdyb.admvs:440100}', recer_admdvs: '', dev_no: '', dev_safe_info: '', signtype: 'S', cainfo: '', infver: '${var.gdyb.infver}', opter_type: '1', opter: '${var.gdyb.userid:magic-api}', opter_name: '${var.gdyb.fixmedins-name}', inf_time: date_format(now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), fixmedins_code: '${var.gdyb.fixmedins-code}', fixmedins_name: '${var.gdyb.fixmedins-name}', recer_sys_code: 'admit', sign_no: '', input: {invinfo: sign.data}}

config.rows: {trade_type: '3501', pk_key: sign.row.pk_value, goods_code: sign.row.fixmedins_hilist_id, goods_name: sign.row.fixmedins_hilist_name, status: '1', in_parm: send.request, result_parm: send.response}

config.sql: update insur_goods_upload_record set status = '0', error_times = error_times + 1, result_parm = #{error.message} where trade_type = '3501' and pk_key = #{sign.row.pk_value} and status <> '9'

insert into insur_goods_upload_record (trade_type, pk_key, goods_code, goods_name, status, error_times, in_parm, result_parm) values ('3501', #{sign.row.pk_value}, #{sign.row.fixmedins_hilist_id}, #{sign.row.fixmedins_hilist_name}, '0', 1, #{error.output.request}, #{error.message})
